model_type: Entity and route-period fixed-effects log-share regression
formula: log(market_share) = beta_fare*log(fare) + beta_capacity*log(seats) + route-carrier effects + route-period effects + error
interpretation: The fare coefficient measures the within-market association between a carrier's fare and passenger share after controlling for its seats, persistent route-carrier differences, and shocks shared by all carriers in the same route-period.
limitation: The estimate remains observational. Time-varying schedule quality, product changes, and fare-setting responses to private demand information can still confound it.
